semantics.mutation_rule: out of place unless canonical cast returns an exact identity, which cannot occur for non-I32 input
semantics.alias_rule: delegates canonical cast_to storage and publication semantics
semantics.dtype_rule: casts to canonical I32 with source conversion rules
semantics.device_rule: preserves canonical input device through the certified cast owner
semantics.numeric_rule: canonical dtype conversion including truncation and range behavior
semantics.cancellation_points: at the public adapter boundary and canonical cast checkpoints
semantics.jvp_rule: integral cast has no floating tangent
